title: Dardo ghamo alam
body:
dard o gham o alam ki aziyat ki raat hai
zarbat ki raat hai ye shahadat ki raat hai
<<DIVIDER>>
mayoos zindagi hai sare paak dekh kar
maula ke doston pe musibat ki raat hai
zarbat ki raat hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
kya dardnaak dard yateemi ki hai khaza
aulaad ro rahi hai ke furqat ki raat hai
zarbat ki raat hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
kehti hai sar ke zakhm se ro ro ke ye namaz
doobi hui lahoo may ibadat ki raat hai
zarbat ki raat hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
quran ke harf harf se behne laga hai khoon
shariye mohamadi pe musibat ki raat hai
zarbat ki raat hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
rone do mujhko mai hoo azadare murtaza
islam keh raha hai ye wehshat ki raat hai
zarbat ki raat hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
jaate hue janaze pe zainab ka tha bayan
dunya se chain uth gaya aafat ki raat hai
zarbat ki raat hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
aale nabi ka tha ali fitrat yehi bayan
kaise kategi raat qayamat ki raat hai
zarbat ki raat hai...
author: Ali Fitrat
